purpose: The measurement corpus for the falsifier harness and the discrimination, redundancy and null gates. Authored intent and derived state never share a file.

block-a.role: public block: genre varies maximally while translator and markup stay constant
block-a.derived: block-a.lock.json (content hashes; written by `python -m isda.corpus build-a`)
block-a.text: corpus/cache/block-a/ (never committed; rebuilt from the public-domain source)

block-b.role: private block: working markdown of the kind the tool is run against, sampled from a private document tree
block-b.derived: block-b.json (opaque ids, genre labels, content hashes, sizes)
block-b.text: corpus/cache/block-b/ (never committed; the documents are not published)

specimens.role: named specimens carrying their framework claims as executable assertions
